start: Owner signed in; the gym has no pass member yet

steps.action: Members, add a member; tick 'Comes with a pass (FITPASS, cultpass and others)'
user_sees: Hint: 'They pay a pass company, not your gym. No plan and no dues, and never on the renewal list. Each visit counts for the pass company.'
Chips 'FITPASS' and 'cultpass', and a box to type another company
must_not: A plan or a fee asked for a pass member

steps.action: Pick 'FITPASS' and save
user_sees: The member's page; a 'Pass visit' button in place of the everyday check-in words; 'Pass visits this month'
must_not: 'Expired' or 'No plan' warnings on a pass member
A second 'Sell membership' button lower on the page

steps.action: Tap 'Pass visit'
user_sees: 'Pass visit counted for FITPASS.'
must_not: Two visits for one day after a second tap
The visit counted as an ordinary visit only

steps.action: Open Visits, then 'Pass visits'
user_sees: Page 'Pass visits', 'Visits by FITPASS, cultpass and other pass members'
'Pass members pay a pass company like FITPASS or cultpass, and the company pays your gym for each visit. Match these counts with the company’s monthly payment.'
Tiles 'Pass visits' 1 and 'Pass members who came' 1 for this month
Table 'Visits by pass company' and the list 'Who came on a pass'
must_not: A count that differs from the register for that month

steps.action: Use the export on that page
user_sees: A file with the columns Date, Pass company, Member, Mobile, Checked in by; 'Exported 1 pass visit.'
must_not: 'Exported 1 pass visits.'
Visits of another month in the file

start: Owner; a pass member exists; the member opens the MettleUp app and scans the gym's check-in QR

steps.action: Open Visits, 'Pass visits' after the scan
user_sees: The visit is counted for the member's pass company; the file says 'MettleUp app QR' under 'Checked in by'
must_not: A QR check-in from before the day they became a pass member counted
The QR visit missing from the count

steps.action: Add another member, tick the pass box and type 'fit pass'
user_sees: Saved as 'FITPASS' (one company, however it is typed)
must_not: Two rows 'FITPASS' and 'fit pass' in the monthly table

steps.action: Add a member with a company of your own, for example 'Urban Pass'
user_sees: Next time the member form offers 'Urban Pass' as a chip after FITPASS and cultpass
must_not: A name longer than 40 letters cut without a word to the user

steps.action: Open Members and tap the 'Pass members' chip
user_sees: Only the pass members, with the count on the chip
must_not: The chip shown in a gym with no pass member

steps.action: Tick 'Comes with a pass (FITPASS, cultpass and others)', leave the company empty, save
user_sees: 'Pick or type the pass company.'; nothing saved
must_not: A pass member saved with no company
The form closing

steps.action: In a gym with no pass member and no pass visit, open Visits
user_sees: No 'Pass visits' entry at the top
must_not: An empty Pass visits page offered to a gym that has no pass members

steps.action: With a pass member but no visit this month, open 'Pass visits'
user_sees: 'No pass visits in <month>' and 'Add a pass member from Members, then check them in at the desk or let them scan your check-in QR. Each visit counts here.'
must_not: A blank table

start: Owner; a FITPASS member has desk pass visits and QR check-ins last month

steps.action: Open 'Pass visits', pick last month, note the FITPASS count
user_sees: Desk and QR visits together
must_not: A month chip missing for a month that has pass visits

steps.action: Edit the member and untick the pass box (they now pay the gym)
user_sees: The member page reads like an ordinary member again
must_not: Dues invented for the time they were on a pass

steps.action: Open 'Pass visits', last month again
user_sees: The same count as before: last month's visits were pass visits when they happened
must_not: Last month's FITPASS count dropping because the member is no longer a pass member
Past visits moved to another company when the member's company is changed

steps.action: Archive or remove the member
user_sees: Their past pass visits still count; a removed member shows as 'A removed member'
must_not: Visits vanishing from a month the company has not paid yet

start: Owner; a pass member has an old gym plan that ends this week

steps.action: Open Today, 'Renewals due'
user_sees: The pass member is not listed
must_not: A renewal reminder or dues reminder aimed at a pass member

steps.action: Open the member's page
user_sees: 'No dues on a pass' when nothing is owed
must_not: 'Fully paid' or a 'Renew' push on a pass member

steps.action: Export the month from 'Pass visits'
user_sees: A file on this device with names and mobile numbers of this gym's pass members only
must_not: Members of another gym
The file sent anywhere by itself
